objective: Finite same-H realization of the frame-derived charged physical halfspin source, current-induced two actual 3D transverse coordinates, longitudinal Gauss and inclusive field/current/spin event. This is the assigned bounded construction, not full issue222 closure.

concepts.choice: Selected. Two smooth divergence-free vector potentials on R3 couple to one full two-flavour 8-site cube. Their finite canonical norm and actual curl fit finite Gaussian charge electrostatics without compact/noncompact sewing. No supplied magnetic restoration.

Alternative. Single-q transverse plane modes on a torus need a consistent charged longitudinal reference/zero-mode boundary prescription; do not mix their periodic transverse topology silently with free-space charged electrostatics. Not executed or refuted.

units: hbar=1; one common length and energy convention; all coupling, inertia, epsilon, hopping and shapes are input dimensionless parameters, not measured electron constants
field: A(x)=a0 u_z(x)+a1 u_y(x), u_e=(e cross x) exp(-|x|^2/(2 ell^2)). Coordinates a in R2, not compact flux angles. div u=0. curl u=[2e-(|x|^2 e-x(e dot x))/ell^2] exp(-|x|^2/(2ell^2)). Integral u_a dot u_b = I_A delta_ab, I_A=pi^(3/2) ell^5; curl Gram=(5/(2ell^2)) I_A delta_ab. H_E=(p0^2+p1^2)/(2 epsilon I_A); E_T=-sum p_a u_a/(epsilon I_A). The curl Gram is evaluated but NEVER installed as B^2 energy.
matter: Eight sites at cube vertices, two distinct scalar CAR flavours with exactly one particle of each flavour: all64 states, including eight doublons and all virtual transitions. Twelve cube edges use h_ij=-t exp(i sum a_alpha w_ij_alpha)c_j^dag c_i+h.c.; w_ij_alpha=integral_0^1 (G_supplier_width*u_alpha)(r_i+s(r_j-r_i)) dot (r_j-r_i) ds, charge+1. Gaussian smearing is REQUIRED by the same finite-width hopping density: (G_s*u_e)(r)=(ell^2/(ell^2+s^2))^(5/2) (e cross r) exp(-r^2/(2(ell^2+s^2))). Thus the Peierls derivative equals the actual smeared bond-current integral, not a point-link approximation paired with unrelated charge density. Current J_alpha=-partial H/partial a_alpha; contact K_alpha_beta=partial^2 H/partial a_alpha partial a_beta. No isolated response, static curvature, old D or low-state supplier projection is imported.
longitudinal: Supplier particles are Gaussian charge+1 at their sites, with fixed eight Gaussian ions charge-1/4 each: supplier net charge0, not Nflavour neutrality. Core Gaussian rho_c=-N G_sigma(x) with N=0,1,2. H_L=1/(8pi epsilon) sum_AB Q_A Q_B erf(R_AB/sqrt(2(sigma_A^2+sigma_B^2)))/R_AB, diagonal in exact occupations; R=0 limit sqrt(2/pi)/sqrt(sigma_A^2+sigma_B^2). Includes self, supplier-supplier, ions, core-core and core-supplier/ion cross terms. E_L(k)=-i k rho(k)/(epsilon |k|^2) is the same free-space Gauss solution. Charged sectors have flux at infinity and finite Gaussian self-energy, no fictitious neutralizing core background.
body: NEW spherically symmetric rigid Gaussian charged cloud, replacing old six-cloud shape. Its material orientation W has angular momentum L. Frame physical S is LEFT coordinate derivative after exact right colour Gauss/centre sewing, imported only through pure frame_gauss(). rho_c is orientation independent. Integral rho_c x cross A = C_N (a0 e_z+a1 e_y), C_N=-2N sigma^2 (1+sigma^2/ell^2)^(-5/2). H_body=(L+S-C_N a_vec)^2/(2Ic)+(L-C_N a_vec)^2/(2Ir)+S^2/(2If). This is the Legendre transform of one positive angular metric minimally coupled to actual rotating Gaussian current, NOT an identification J=S. All L^2 sectors are exactly invariant, including under field/current/source; chosen source preparation has L=0 and all M,K in that sector. Thus l>0 cannot be virtual intermediate states for these observables. Raw frame j=0,1/2,1 and full colour Fock4 are used to derive physical sectors1,2,1. Colour/CAR/topology and rigid core remain inputs.
current: For core angular velocity Omega=(L+S-C a_vec)/Ic+(L-C a_vec)/Ir, j_c(x)=rho_c(x) Omega cross x, symmetrized where necessary. Mode current = integral j_c dot u_alpha = C Omega_alpha. Its contact C^2(1/Ic+1/Ir) is charged kinetic contact and vanishes at N=0; there is NO leftover bare B^2 or magnetic frequency. The supplier current is the Peierls derivative. Their sum alone drives p_dot=J.
one_H: Direct sum N=0,1,2 of H_E + H_cube(a) + H_L(N,n_i) + H_body(N,L=0). Every field-coordinate, matter and physical frame state in a sector is retained. Dressed source maps adjacent N sectors with identical field/matter coordinates; electrostatic energies are recomputed, no energy repinning.
analytic_closure: Finite Dirichlet field regulator gives self-adjoint bounded-below sparse H. Unregulated hopping is bounded and electrostatics positive; body kinetic squares positive. Neutral H has bounded flux landscape and is not a confining unique-ground theorem on R2. A prepared local well/finite amplitude regulator is explicitly the state family. Full-space rotational invariance is NOT claimed for a fixed cube and two selected modes. Frame halfspin identifies the physical coordinate generator, not total angular conservation of this anisotropic truncation.
numerical_remainder: Whether one shared full supplier and quantum two-coordinate field retain current-bearing field legs and feed a source-normalized physical spin/current event with induction-off and cross-metric-off distinctions. Sparse complex128 diagonalization/orthonormal Rayleigh-Ritz and matrix exponential evolution, full-space resolvents, norm/energy/boundary/source Grams determine the finite-model evidence.
